newsitem.title: BELGIUM: IBT TO BUILD NEW R&D, DISTRIBUTION UNIT.
newsitem.headline: IBT TO BUILD NEW R&D, DISTRIBUTION UNIT.

text.p: Medical products company International Brachytherapy (IBt) said on Monday it bought a 3.5 hectare plot for 3.5 million francs to build a research, development and distribution unit in Seneffe, Belgium.
The purchase is part of 73.5 million francs of 1997 investments, of which 63 millions francs with European Union assistance, John Carden, IBt press officer, said.
Before the end of 1997 IBt will employ 10 people at Seneffe, and 30 in the next three years.
IBt, specialised in the production of implants used in prostate cancer treatment, recently opened an industrial unit in Atlanta, U.S., to distribute medical implants in north America.
